title: FREE REQUEST Looking for people to help with my game!

posts.author: AlceaAkaza
posts.body:
Hello there! I am in need of people to help out on my game that I am currently making!
Shinogono Story is an UTAU fangame being made with RPG Maker MZ. This game is basically a standard RPG with a main focus on スヲウ’s UTAU characters. More info on the game can be found
here
.
Click to expand...
I am currently looking for the following:
Pixel Artists
Programmers (Both JS and Eventing)
Translators (English to Japanese)
Music Composers
For Pixel Artists:
Looking specifically for tileset artists!
Please send me a portfolio of your works to me via DM. (X: @ExeAlceaBreaker | Bsky: @rekishikographer09.bsky.social | Discord: rekishikographer_09)
Previous work with RPG Maker games would be greatly appreciated.
For Programmers:
A basic ~ intermediate knowledge of Javascript and RPG Maker's Eventing System is required in order to sign up for this position.
(Must be for MZ.)
Translators:
An intermediate ~ advanced knowledge and any previous experience of translation to Japanese is required for this position.
Music Composers:
Please send me a portfolio of your works to me via DM. (X: @ExeAlceaBreaker | Bsky: @rekishikographer09.bsky.social | Discord: rekishikographer_09)
Somewhere similar to a styling of
this work
would be appreciated.
Please reply down below or send me a DM on Twitter, Bluesky, or Discord!
